newsitem.title: USA: Boston Scientific sales jump, stock rises.
newsitem.headline: Boston Scientific sales jump, stock rises.

text.p: The stock of Boston Scientific Corp. rose sharply Tuesday, a day after the maker of medical devices said net sales for the second quarter jumped 25 percent.
The stock climbed $6, or almost 10 percent, to $69.25 on Nasdaq at midday.
Boston Scientific said Monday that its sales rose to $474 million in the quarter ended June 30 from $379 million in the second quarter of 1996, in line with expectations.
The Natick, Mass.-based company said sales would have increased 28 percent if changes in foreign currency exchange rates had not eroded international revenues.
The company said reported revenues include the combined net sales of Boston Scientific Corp. and former rival Target Therapeutics Inc., whose acquisition it completed during the second quarter.
The company said it expects to release complete second-quarter financial results later in July.
